question: Who was the Australian Open Women’s Singles champion in 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Naomi Osaka.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Naomi Osaka won her fourth Grand Slam title, adding a second Australian Open to her twin US Open triumphs.**
 
• She won the title after** beating USA's Jennifer Brady 6-4, 6-3 **in the 2021 Australian Open women's singles final in Melbourne.
 
• **Osaka became the first woman since Monica Seles, and the first player since Roger Federer to win her first four Grand Slam finals.**
 
• **Novak Djokovic defended the men's singles title **as he** claimed his 18th Grand Slam title,** defeating Daniil Medvedev.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__** 

__
 
• **Grand Slams of Tennis:**

 
 
• ​The Grand Slam itinerary consists of:
 
 
• **the Australian Open in mid-January, **
 
• **the French Open (also known as Roland Garros) from around late May to early June, **
 
• **Wimbledon in June–July, and **
 
• **the US Open in August–September.**
 
 
 
• Each tournament is played over a two-week period.
 
 
 
• **Rafael Nadal **is the winner of **most Grand Slams titles with 22 titles to his name.​**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Rafael Nadal **defeated Daniil Medvedev, to** win** **the men's singles** tennis title at the** 2022 Australian Open.**
 
• **Ashleigh Barty **defeated Danielle Collins to **win the women's singles** tennis title at the **2022 Australian Open.**
